How the relationship works

A collaborator at the design table.

We participate early enough to support the creative direction, then remain involved through installation, programming and final tuning.

01

Understand the design intent

Review plans, finishes, key elevations, lighting concepts and how each space is meant to feel.

02

03

Confirm locations and technical requirements with the project team before irreversible finish work begins.

04

Install and tune the system with careful alignment, clean detailing and respect for the completed interior.
